# Ecosystem Competitors

These are **not vendors**. They are statutory infrastructure, and no institution can opt out of the CRITICAL rows. They are also the reason the problem exists.

![Mandatory stack](../_exports/charts/phase9/p9_06_mandatory_stack.png)

## The one-paragraph version

The spec's example is right: Startup India already offers ecosystem networking, startup directories, mentors, incubators, investors, resources and programmes. **What none of them does is give anything back to the institution.** Startup India records the startup; the IIC Portal records the activity; YUKTI-NIR records the innovation; ARIIA scores the institution. Nobody joins them, and nobody returns a figure an IIC coordinator can use.

## In detail

### Startup India Hub — DPIIT

- **Unit of record.** the startup profile
- **What it gives.** 50,000+ startup directory; investors, mentors, incubators, accelerators; 30+ government bodies registered; free tools, templates, courses, challenges; Innovation Challenges with cash grants
- **What it takes.** connection requests (3/week cap); startup-level only
- **What it returns to the institution.** **NOTHING BACK TO INSTITUTIONS.** No IIC activity, no ARIIA/NIRF evidence, no TRL. This is the single most important line in this phase.
- **Overlap with StartupHub.** DIRECT on networking, directory, mentors, incubators. ZERO on institutional innovation compliance.
- **Threat.** HIGH
- **Note.** Network claimed at 600K registered members.
- **Source.** <https://www.startupindia.gov.in/content/sih/en/startup-hub.html>

### BHASKAR — DPIIT

- **Unit of record.** the individual/entity identity
- **What it gives.** Bharat Startup Knowledge Access Registry; personas Mentor, Enabler, Explorer, Startup Founder, Individual Investor, Traditional Business Owner; industry alliances by sector/tech/geography
- **What it takes.** a completed profile before you become visible and searchable
- **What it returns to the institution.** **NOTHING BACK TO INSTITUTIONS.** Identity layer, not an innovation record.
- **Overlap with StartupHub.** Identity and discovery. No institutional compliance overlap at all.
- **Threat.** HIGH
- **Note.** Registration now redirects through BHASKAR before DPIIT recognition runs in parallel.
- **Source.** <https://www.startupindia.gov.in/bhaskar>

### MAARG — DPIIT / Startup India

- **Unit of record.** the mentor-startup pairing
- **What it gives.** AI mentor-startup matching at scale; interaction tracking for impact; video calls; mentor recognition; custom programmes by enablers; feedback and grievance mechanism
- **What it takes.** mentor profile moderation 24–48h
- **What it returns to the institution.** **NOTHING BACK TO INSTITUTIONS.** Mentorship hours are not logged against any scheme's utilisation requirement.
- **Overlap with StartupHub.** DIRECT on mentor matching. This is the closest government analogue to StartupHub's mentor module.
- **Threat.** HIGH
- **Note.** GAP-07 (NDA-tiered mentor visibility) is NOT solved here either.
- **Source.** <https://maarg.startupindia.gov.in/>

### Startup India Investor Connect — NSAC / DPIIT

- **Unit of record.** the investor-startup introduction
- **What it gives.** dedicated platform connecting startups to investors by sector, function, stage, geography, background
- **What it takes.** registration
- **What it returns to the institution.** **NOTHING BACK TO INSTITUTIONS.**
- **Overlap with StartupHub.** Investor discovery only.
- **Threat.** MEDIUM
- **Note.** Launched at the 6th NSAC meeting, 11 March 2023.
- **Source.** <https://www.startupindia.gov.in/content/sih/en/about-startup-india-initiative.html>

### IIC Portal — MoE Innovation Cell

- **Unit of record.** the activity/event
- **What it gives.** Institution's Innovation Council registration; star rating 1–5; Performance Card; 16+ activities/year each a full evidence submission
- **What it takes.** 16+ evidence submissions per year, maintained by hand
- **What it returns to the institution.** Nothing - this IS the record. But it returns nothing machine-readable.
- **Overlap with StartupHub.** **TOTAL, AND MANDATORY.** No institution can opt out. This is the demand driver.
- **Threat.** CRITICAL
- **Note.** GOV-018/022. 17 menus, no venture-entity module.
- **Source.** <https://iic.gov.in/>

### YUKTI-NIR — MoE MIC + AICTE

- **Unit of record.** the innovation snapshot
- **What it gives.** TRL banding (Idea/PoC 1–4, Innovation/Prototype 5–9, Business/Startup); institute-side verification with Recommended/Not-Recommended gating; auto-flows to ARIIA
- **What it takes.** every innovation, institute-verified
- **What it returns to the institution.** Improved ARIIA Section 4 ranking - a budget line that already exists.
- **Overlap with StartupHub.** **TOTAL, AND MANDATORY.**
- **Threat.** CRITICAL
- **Note.** GOV-023/024. The reason TRL is non-optional (GAP-02).
- **Source.** <https://yuktinir-mic.in/>

### NIRF Innovation — MoE

- **Unit of record.** the spreadsheet row
- **What it gives.** Ranking; 5 marks hinge on one countable (startups recognised)
- **What it takes.** ~11 screens PER DISCIPLINE, per startup
- **What it returns to the institution.** Ranking, and funding consequences.
- **Overlap with StartupHub.** **TOTAL, AND MANDATORY.**
- **Threat.** CRITICAL
- **Note.** GOV-028. Phase 3A measured the operational cost: 32/354 startups lose identity (9%).
- **Source.** <https://www.nirfindia.org/>

### ARIIA — AIM / Atal Innovation Mission

- **Unit of record.** the institution-year + innovation rows
- **What it gives.** Ranking; incumbent performance data; 100+ indicators across 5 categories
- **What it takes.** 100+ indicators annually
- **What it returns to the institution.** Ranking, and institutional funding.
- **Overlap with StartupHub.** **TOTAL, AND MANDATORY.**
- **Threat.** CRITICAL
- **Note.** GOV-032. Demands 'Patent Application No' and 'Year of Patent Application' - the mandate behind GAP-01.
- **Source.** <https://ariia.gov.in/>

### AISHE — DoHE

- **Unit of record.** the institution-year aggregate
- **What it gives.** National registry; the statistical frame behind every count in this study
- **What it takes.** binary innovation items only
- **What it returns to the institution.** Aggregate visibility.
- **Overlap with StartupHub.** Indirect - it defines the market, not the workflow.
- **Threat.** LOW
- **Note.** 58,643 registered HEIs - the super-bound from Phase 7.
- **Source.** <https://aishe.gov.in/>

### State Startup Portals — State Governments

- **Unit of record.** the state ecosystem record
- **What it gives.** State Startup Ranking (SRF) results; policy schemes; state nodal teams
- **What it takes.** state reporting
- **What it returns to the institution.** Ranking and scheme access.
- **Overlap with StartupHub.** Segment G9 - sized separately in Phase 7 on the PRIOR tier.
- **Threat.** MEDIUM
- **Note.** Phase 6: 34 states ranked, 8 fell tiers, 0 Emerging-tier reports obtainable.
- **Source.** <https://www.startupindia.gov.in/>
